properties.displayName: Entra - Unusual Successful Device Code Authentication
properties.description: [Added 2026 threat-model expansion] Detects successful device-code authentication that originates from an IP not previously seen for that user in device-code flows, or is marked medium/high risk. Device-code phishing is increasingly used to obtain cloud sessions without traditional password capture.
properties.query:
let CurrentWindow=1h;
let Lookback=14d;
let Historical =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(Lookback)..ago(CurrentWindow))
    | where ResultType == '0' and AuthenticationProtocol =~ 'deviceCode'
    | summarize KnownIPs=make_set(IPAddress,256), KnownCountries=make_set(Location,64) by UserPrincipalName;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(CurrentWindow)
| where ResultType == '0' and AuthenticationProtocol =~ 'deviceCode'
| join kind=leftouter Historical on UserPrincipalName
| extend IsNewIP = isempty(tostring(KnownIPs)) or not(set_has_element(KnownIPs, IPAddress)),
         IsNewCountry = isempty(tostring(KnownCountries)) or not(set_has_element(KnownCountries, Location))
| where IsNewIP or IsNewCountry or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in~ ('medium','high') or RiskState in~ ('atRisk','confirmedCompromised')
| extend Name=tostring(split(UserPrincipalName,'@')[0]), UPNSuffix=tostring(split(UserPrincipalName,'@')[1])
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Name, UPNSuffix, UserId, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName, AppId,
          AuthenticationProtocol, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, IsNewIP, IsNewCountry, SessionId, OriginalTransferMethod
